title: MLOps
description: The practices and tooling that take a machine-learning model from a notebook to reliable production: experiment tracking, model registries, feature stores, CI/CD for ML, serving, and drift monitoring. Builds on this library's docker-and-containers, kubernetes-fundamentals, harness, opentelemetry, and testing-in-software-engineering courses for the general infra/CI/testing/observability mechanics this course specializes for ML — see each for the foundation.

changelog.notes: Initial release — 24 decks, each pack with a preview card teaching the concept before its graded main card and practice cards.
Wrapped code, commands and file names in backticks so they render as code (1 card(s)).
Code mentioned inside question and answer text (commands, function calls, keywords such as for/None/True, file names, flags) is now marked as code, so it shows in the code font and colors.
Fixed cards the app could not import (a fill-in-the-blank question with no blank, a matching pair with no partner), so the course now installs.
Added an explanation to 28 card(s) that had none.
